detail: The vocabulary purge moved check's per-project knobs (--runs and friends) into gate config but left four repo callers passing the deleted flag, so the guard replay step exited 2 with a usage error in CI; separately the policy gate errored on the force-pushed range whose before-sha was orphaned. Both defects live in CI wiring, so no runtime guard can hold them; the bounded regression test greps every workflow and self-dogfood runner for dead check flags, failing on the parent (the callers still pass --runs) and passing on the fix (callers rely on gate.runs: 3 in the project config, pinned by the ci-enforcement contract).
